verdict.rationale: Snowflake documents pieces that touch parts of this story — dbt Projects on Snowflake brings the 'develop, deploy, orchestrate, observe' lifecycle (implying versioning via dbt's git-based workflow) and Time Travel lets you restore/rollback data state — but there is no documented feature for versioning, reviewing, or rolling back automation logic itself (Tasks, Dynamic Tables, stored procedures, CLI-deployed apps). Missing for 10: explicit version history/diff for task or procedure definitions, a review/approval workflow for automation changes, and a documented rollback mechanism for automation code (not just underlying data).
